{{Top|leg}}
'''Ribbon charges''' were tape-like strings of explosives that could be unrolled and stuck to various surfaces. When detonated the explosion would follow the tape and only blow out that section of the surface. At one point, [[Darman Skirata|Darman]] used some to great effect.
